title: 第13章 秋汛第14章 水妖上岸
content_zh:
祁云看了他一眼，没说话，只是冲着仆从挥了挥手，示意他们都退下去。
前堂里，就只剩下了父子二人，和这位老巫祝。
“太公方才那番话，怕是不止说给宴席上那些人听的。”
祁澜率先开口。
谢颂搁下碗。
“世子聪慧，老朽就不绕弯子了。”
他撑着鸠杖站起身，走到堂中，偏头看了祁云一眼。
“世子得天所眷，创下琥珀晶糖与新肥之法，前者为我邦国聚财之术，只需控制其产能，使其不出于作坊之内，自可为百年之基，然后者……恐怕世子与主君皆知，此法或可守得几年？十年？还是二十年？想来是守不了那么久的，便是能守个三五年，就已经不错了。“
”太公之意，是将此法择一时机，献于商王？“
祁澜若有所思道。
”不错。“
谢太公赞许地看了祁澜一眼。
”世子与老朽是想到一块去了。
此新肥之法，可使我长溪国力大升，不过终究不可能永远留住的，但若是在那之前，找个合适的时机，将此法进献于商王，敢问世子与主君，可换得一天将真功否？”
“想来不止，除了这天将真功，便是以此将我家升为伯侯，都是够格。”
祁云摸着短须，不住点头道，眼中满是火热。
新肥之法，要在整个邦国推行，加上要收集粪便、草木灰等，要什么材料，需要多少时间，是根本瞒不住的，加之流程也不复杂，哪怕有心隐瞒，恐怕也瞒不住多长时间，若是请那些有道术在身的练气士出手，就更不可能瞒得住了。
趁着还没传出去的时候积攒国力，等到合适的时机拿来换一个天境功法，的确是利益最大化的主意。
“太公此乃老成谋国之言，此计若成，他日我长溪，必是这巴蜀之地第四个侯国！”
“老夫此言，言尽于此，只是在进献之前，定要守好着新肥法，切莫让其他人盗了去，另外，还可对外言说，此为世子得巫师助力，方能使得田亩增产，牵涉神鬼医巫之事，也可令人捉摸不透，难以寻找放心。

当然，世子、主君若有其他想法，我巫寮之内，也自当尽力辅佐。”
为邦国献策，定下晋子成侯的战略规划，顺带着还为自己和巫寮里的徒子徒孙借势搭车，这谢老太公，果真是人老成精。
“便依太公所言，此事以农寮、兵寮、巫寮三部并行，农寮行收集、生产之事，兵寮严加看守，行戒备之事，巫寮混淆视听，行掩护之事，各司其职，分步生产，上下内外隔绝，仅我三人可知具体，勿使外界有窥察之机。”
祁澜拱手道。
祁云在一旁看着祁澜所做出的安排，满意的摸了摸胡须，不住点头。
密议结束，祁澜与父亲、谢太公一同走出前堂。
一出门，屋外，风雨依旧，隐隐有雷光在天边闪动。
“太公，这雨，何时才会停下？”
content_en:
Qi Yun glanced at him and said nothing. He just waved his hand at the servants and motioned for them to retreat.
In the front hall, only the father and son, and the old wizard Zhu were left.
"What the Grand Duke just said was probably not just for those at the banquet."
Qi Lan spoke first.
Xie Song put down the bowl.
"Your Majesty is smart, and the old man won't beat around the bush."
He stood up with his dove stick, walked into the hall, and glanced at Qi Yun.
"The prince has been favored by heaven and created the method of amber crystal sugar and new fertilizer. The former is a method of accumulating wealth for our country. As long as its production capacity is controlled so that it does not come out of the workshop, it can be the foundation for a hundred years. The second... I am afraid that both the prince and the lord know how many years this method can be maintained? Ten? Or twenty years? I think it cannot be maintained for that long. Even if it can be maintained for three to five years, it will be good."
"Tai Gong's intention is to choose an opportunity to offer this method to King Shang?"
Qi Lan said thoughtfully.
"Not bad."
Grand Duke Xie glanced at Qi Lan approvingly.
"The prince and the old man thought of getting together.
This new fertilizer method can greatly increase the power of our country in Changxi, but after all, it cannot be retained forever. But if we find a suitable opportunity before that and offer this method to King Shang, dare I ask the prince and the lord, can I exchange it for a day of true power? "
"I can't stop thinking about it. In addition to this Heavenly General's true skill, even if I use it to promote my family to Bohou, they are all qualified."
Qi Yun touched his short beard and nodded, his eyes full of fire.
The new fertilizer method needs to be implemented throughout the country. In addition, feces, plant ash, etc. need to be collected. What materials are required and how much time it takes are impossible to hide. In addition, the process is not complicated. Even if you deliberately conceal it, I am afraid it will not be concealed for long. If you ask those Qi practitioners with Taoist skills to take action, it will be even more impossible to conceal it.
It is indeed the best idea to maximize the benefits by accumulating national strength before it is spread out, and waiting for the right time to exchange it for a heavenly realm technique.
"Tai Gong, this is what an old man said to plan for the country. If this plan is successful, one day our Changxi will be the fourth princely state in the Bashu land!"
"That's it for what I said. But before you donate it, you must abide by the new fertilizer law and don't let others steal it. In addition, you can also tell the outside world that this is the prince's help from the wizard to increase the yield of the fields. It involves gods, ghosts, healers, and witches, which can also be unpredictable and difficult to find and reassure.
Of course, if the Crown Prince or Lord has other ideas, I, the witch house, will do our best to assist. "
Offering advice to the country, formulating the strategic plan for Jin Zi to become a Marquis, and also taking advantage of the opportunity to give himself and his disciples and grandsons in the witch house a ride, this old lady Xie is really a man who has matured with age.
"According to what Taigong said, this matter is carried out in parallel by three departments: the Nongxiao, the Bingliao, and the Wuxiao. The Nongxiao is responsible for collection and production. The soldiers are strictly guarded and guarded. The Wuxia is responsible for confusing the public and acting as a cover. Each performs its own duties and produces in steps. The upper and lower parts are isolated from the inside and outside. Only the three of us can know the details, so as not to allow outsiders to spy."
Qi Lan cupped his hands and said.
Qi Yun looked at the arrangements made by Qi Lan, touched his beard with satisfaction, and kept nodding.
After the secret discussion was over, Qi Lan walked out of the front hall with his father and Taigong Xie.
As soon as I went out, outside the house, the wind and rain were still there, and there was a faint thunder flashing in the sky.
"Grandpa, when will this rain stop?"
